seoDescription: What {{portal}} is, where its information comes from, and how it is checked.
title: About {{portal}}
intro: {{portal}} is an independent, community-led website that gathers public information about the {{lgu}} in one place, and says where each piece of it comes from.
notOfficial: It is not the official website of the {{lgu}}, and it is not run by or affiliated with the City Government. For official transactions, go to the City Government's own offices and channels.

coverage.title: What you can find here
items: Elected officials, city offices and barangays
City services from the Citizen's Charter
Receipts and expenditures, procurement notices and public works
Ordinances posted by the Sangguniang Panlungsod

sources.title: How the information is checked
items: Every record cites the official document or page it comes from, and the date it was last checked.
Where official sources disagree, or only one source names something, the field is marked as not verified instead of guessed.
Nothing is made up. If you spot something wrong, you can report it.

origin.title: How it is built
origin.body: {{portal}} is open source. It is built on a template first made for another town's community portal, and it is listed in the Better LGU directory alongside portals for other towns and cities.

license.title: License
license.description: The site's code and content are released under the
license.explanation: dedication, so anyone may reuse them for any purpose.

cta.title: Help improve it
cta.body: Corrections, official sources, translations and code are all welcome.
